title: Essex County Club
specs: Blue jeans are not permitted on Club property

Golf attire: men must wear slacks or mid-length shorts and a tucked-in collared shirt; women must wear shirts, golf skirts, slacks or Bermuda shorts; blue jeans, cut-offs, short shorts, slogan tee shirts, tennis clothes, bathing suits, tank tops, and halter-tops are not acceptable

Racquets attire: court attire including warm-ups and hats must be white or off-white with minor colored trim acceptable; males must wear a collared tennis shirt; substantially white tennis shoes encouraged; basketball, squash or running shoes not acceptable
Use of electronic devices is strictly prohibited on Club property except in clubhouse phone booths and personal vehicles
blurb: Essex County Club offers golf and racquet sports with specific dress codes for each. The club prohibits blue jeans and certain casual attire on the property. Use of electronic devices is restricted to designated areas only.
